messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition introducing the addressees | **Al** | to | OK | | **le** | definite article (plural) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | **quai** | relative pronoun “those” | **tiuj** | those | OK | | **poi** | adverb “later, thereafter” | **poste** | thereafter | OK | | **se** | conditional conjunction “if” | **se** | if | OK | | **tu** | 2nd‑person singular pronoun “you” | **vi** | you | OK | | **vorrai** | future verb “will want” | **volos** | will want | OK | | **salire** | infinitive “to ascend” | **leviĝi** | to ascend | OK | | **anima** | noun “soul” | **Animo** | soul | OK | | **fia** | future copula “shall be” | **estos** | shall be | OK | | **a** | preposition introducing the domain of worthiness | **pri** | for/about | OK | | **ciò** | demonstrative pronoun “that” | **tio** | that | OK | | **più** | comparative adverb “more” | **pli** | more | OK | | **di** | preposition introducing the standard of comparison “than” | **ol** | than | OK | | **me** | 1st‑person pronoun “I” (object) | **mi** | I | OK | | **degna** | adjective “worthy” | **inda** | worthy | OK | | **con** | preposition “with” | **Kun** | with | OK | | **lei** | pronoun “her” | **ŝi** | her | OK | | **ti** | 2nd‑person pronoun (accusative) “you” | **vin** | you | OK | | **lascerò** | future verb “will leave” | **lasos** | will leave | OK | | **nel** | contraction “in the” (preposition) | **ĉe** | at | OK | | **mio** | possessive adjective “my” | **mia** | my | OK | | **partire** | infinitive nominalized “departure” | **foriro** | departure | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: *le* – Esperanto does not use definite articles, so the source article is omitted in the translation.
No other words are missing, wrong, or grammatically mismatched.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 121: - Original: Al tiuj se vi volos poste leviĝi, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 122: - Original: Animo estos pli inda ol mi pri tio: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 123: - Original: Kun ŝi mi lasos vin ĉe mia foriro; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` Al tiuj se vi volos poste leviĝi, Animo estos pli inda ol mi pri tio: Kun ŝi mi lasos vin ĉe mia foriro; ```
